purpose: Measure exact hybrid CUDA-reservoir plus native sparse-output inference and online teaching at 200,000 genuinely active fitted cells, identify the dominant phase, and preserve the >100 end-to-end tokens/s engineering gate.
claim_boundary: This is a synthetic engineering benchmark only. It does not measure language or SWE capability, does not authorize access to held-out data, and is not evidence of biological fidelity.

timing.clock: time.perf_counter_ns for end-to-end and host phases; CUDA events for recurrent kernel
timing.inference_definition: observe(token) plus race(), where race includes sparse fitted-output current and first-spike arbitration
timing.training_definition: observe(token) plus strengthen(target), where strengthen includes fitted-output race, teaching-evoked target post gate, synapse-local update, homeostasis, and scheduled turnover
timing.repeat_state: construct and bootstrap an independent identical circuit for each repeat
timing.incremental_persistence: write the artifact after every completed repeat

decision_rule.move_sparse_readout_to_cuda_only_if: The isolated sparse current call or strengthen-minus-observe phase is at least 20% of end-to-end time, or exact hybrid remains below 100 tokens/s after any justified transfer reduction.
decision_rule.optimize_transfer_if: The exact host arrays required by sparse current/plasticity are a strict subset of per-token downloads and end-to-end wall time exceeds CUDA-event kernel time by at least 10%.
decision_rule.exactness_requirement: Any optimization must retain the registered real-CUDA lifecycle parity gate and must never silently fall back.
decision_rule.state_requirement: All 200,000 reservoir cells remain active and updated every integration step; no dormant padding may be claimed as simulated work.
